report.explanation: Code review B of the frozen e04s02 candidate (sha256 matches specs/verifications/e04s02-round1-source.json). Checks were NOT RUN by this reviewer. Parent evidence cited, not re-executed: artifact://1266 workspace 372 pass / 30 suites / 10 ignored, strict clippy/check/build/fmt, Bun 8/49, Zsh syntax; artifact://1269 22 library + 19 e04s02 cases; parent CLI/controlling-PTY probes on a synthetic stdio peer. Score = 100*(32-0)/32 = 100. Must-fix 0, should-fix 0, consider findings 0. No actionable Fowler smell should change before merge: Broker::commit is a long method because every fallible reservation must stay before the no-publish barrier, not because of a divergent abstraction. Limitations, not deductions: pattern/format are displayed and explicitly not certified; number bounds are finite f64, while integers use the locked serde_json 1.0.152 i64 representation (Float tokens are not as_i64); view reconciliation is bounded by 1088 records and is not an asymptotic claim; no live provider/auth/model or S03/S04 proof; historical e03 native fence remains failed. 01 exact target/connection/session binding PASS: Instance::exact and prepare/commit require the full tuple; forms require sessionId XOR requestId, and session scope must match the live session. 02 current control/generation PASS: Authority::admit_acp checks the live generation under the target lock, and commit rejects a mismatched checked generation; the view captures generation and discards on change. 03 first-valid atomic admission/revoke order PASS: reservations and validation precede calls/work/enqueue; a second answer sees a non-pending interaction. 04 unique calls/work/history and no loser PASS: call IDs are inserted only after fallible checks; the loser is absent from calls, work, and the wire. 05 typed inbound IDs PASS: RequestId number and string do not alias; null is its own ID, not another type. 06 responder in-flight/stamped reuse PASS: the wire ID stays reserved until the write stamp, and finish_response ignores a stamp whose AtomicU8 is no longer the current responder. 07 original request scope/lifetime PASS: a request-scoped form must name an outstanding RPC; parent completion marks the parent completed and keeps the original responder. 08 asynchronous bootstrap/auth PASS: a bootstrap request-scoped form is not treated as the current prompt; the auth-scoped fixture stays pending across interrupt. 09 raw schema before coercion PASS: validate_form_schema runs before CreateElicitationRequest decode, and the stored schema is the raw object; toolCallId is rejected before DefaultOnError can drop it. 10 all known field types PASS: flat string, number, integer, boolean, untitled enum, titled oneOf, and string-array multiselect are validated and rendered; nested/unknown types are rejected. 11 required/unset/default distinctions PASS: API omission does not apply defaults; false, zero, and empty remain explicit; F4 unsets; editor defaults are reviewed before F5 accept and are not auto-submitted. 12 bounds/finite/i64/Unicode/enum intersection PASS: integer tokens use as_i64, which rejects f64 tokens in this serde_json; numbers must be finite; lengths are Unicode scalar counts; enum/oneOf intersection and distinct multiselect are enforced. 13 actual offered permission IDs/kinds PASS: only decoded allow/reject once/always options are stored, and the response carries the offered option_id. 14 no dismiss/implicit allow/deny PASS: Escape, focus, detach, and paste do not select or deny; no allow-once is synthesized. 15 exact form decline/cancel PASS: decline, form cancel, and permission Cancelled are distinct; interrupt uses cancel, not decline. 16 local validation limitations/unsupported errors PASS: pattern/format are shown with an explicit non-certification banner; URL mode, unknown methods, and fs/terminal requests get invalid_params or method_not_found; initialize advertises form only. 17 atomic cancel frame/content reservations PASS: session/cancel plus every required response is capacity-checked, and interaction bytes are retained, before enqueue. 18 late nonselectable requests/no duplicate selected reply PASS: a late applicable request is inserted already selected under the cancel work; an already selected interaction is not answered again; malformed or foreign requests get an error response. 19 original-response interrupt truthfulness PASS: only the original prompt stop_reason is recorded; writing session/cancel does not confirm cancellation. 20 force/pending-cancel/retained-call invariants PASS: force remains an authority grant in control.rs; this broker has no implicit interrupt, signal, or kill. 21 native draft capture/invalidation/no replay PASS: the first edit captures target, control, generation, interaction, and revision; identity changes discard; there is no optimistic accepted history. 22 original native provenance and all structured routes PASS: daemon acp_action authorizes then admit_acp for acp-answer and acp-permission; the editor envelope keeps the captured control rather than substituting the current token. 23 restore only original synchronous unqueued action PASS: NativeControl returns the owned envelope only on synchronous queue rejection, and restore_unqueued requires that same binding, revision, and call id while still pending. 24 canonical truthful display/cache PASS: top-level interactions and drain events are metadata-only; question, schema, options, and selection stay in include_content; disposition updates do not rebuild immutable schema facts. 25 count/byte/history/resource bounds PASS: 64 responders, 64 fields, 256 options, 1MiB frames, 64KiB answers, 4MiB interaction content, 1024 completed records, and 4096 call tombstones are enforced before publication; live responders are not evicted. View metadata headroom is 512 bytes times 1088 records, above the roughly 260-byte content-record overhead. 26 writer/FIFO/lock responsiveness PASS: the writer blocks on the pipe outside the state lock; the application consumer does not wait for another response; stderr keeps draining. 27 process/worker/sentinel cleanup PASS: setsid, birth-qualified ProcessTree, and outside-lock join remain; uncertain process identity stays charged. Parent probes reported normal exit and sentinel survival; this reviewer did not re-run them. 28 privacy/no raw metadata/content leak PASS: snapshots and acp-updated events use projection metadata; tool content strips _meta and control characters; no credential or URL login workflow is added. 29 inert terminal rendering/no command injection PASS: ACP text reaches Ratatui only after control, bidi, and line-separator escaping; adapter argv is not a shell. 30 project scope/types/supply chain/conventions PASS: no dependency or shared-routing signature change; workers stayed in the owned ACP and view files; stable IDs and explicit errors are preserved. 31 behavioral test and actual runtime quality PASS on parent evidence only: unit tests assert wire frames, dispositions, and rejected losers, and parent CLI/PTY probes cover fields, permissions, races, decline versus cancel, interrupt, the 65th form, and the byte ceiling. Not executed here, and not treated as runtime acceptance. 32 clarity/maintainability/docs PASS: README and CHANGELOG state keys, 64KiB defaults, pattern/format non-certification, interrupt truthfulness, and the live-provider non-claim.
